description: Insert an image into an existing design — a poster, creative, or any page. Either AI-GENERATE one from `prompt` (costs coins, respects the project's AI-image toggle) OR drop in an existing image by `image_url` (a public http(s) URL). Optional `placement` positions it ('top right', 'center', 'bottom left', …) — it goes in as a movable overlay you can reposition/resize afterward with sketchxflow_edit. Then view the result with sketchxflow_get_image.

height.description: Generated image height in px (default 600). Only used with prompt.

image_model.description: Optional. Pin which model generates this design's AI images — a PAID-PLAN feature (Starter and above). OMIT IT unless the user asked for a specific image model: omitting uses the account's default (gemini-3.1-flash-image) and is the normal path. Passing it on a free plan fails the call. Valid ids: gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image (Nano Banana Lite — fastest and cheapest); gemini-3.1-flash-image (Nano Banana 2 — default; balanced quality and speed); gemini-3-pro-image (Nano Banana Pro — highest fidelity, ~2x the coins). This is NOT `model`: `model` picks the LLM that writes the page, this picks the model that renders the PICTURES in it. The two id lists are separate and passing one where the other belongs fails with a 400.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of an existing image to insert. Provide this OR prompt.

placement.description: Where to place it: top left / top right / bottom left / bottom right / top / bottom / left / right / center. Default center.

project_id.description: The project to add the image to.

prompt.description: Describe an image to AI-generate (costs coins). Provide this OR image_url.

slug.description: Page slug. Default 'home' (the main page / creative).

width.description: Generated image width in px (default 800). Only used with prompt.

name: sketchxflow_add_image
title: Add an image to a design (poster / creative / page)
